pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena upāsakena saṅghaṃ uddissa vihāro kārāpito hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.3: so tassa vihārassa mahe ubhato saṅghassa akālacīvaraṃ dātukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.4: tena kho pana samayena ubhato saṅghassa kaṭhinaṃ atthataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.5: atha kho so upāsako saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā kaṭhinuddhāraṃ yāci,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.7: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.12: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho kaṭhinaṃ uddhareyya
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.16: yassāyasmato khamati kaṭhinassa ubbhāro so tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.18: ubbhataṃ saṅghena kaṭhinaṃ khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.1: atha kho so upāsako bhikkhunisaṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā kaṭhinuddhāraṃ yāci.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.4: atha kho so upāsako ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.5: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo amhākaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ na dassantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tassa upāsakassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.7: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.8: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā dhammikaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ paṭibāhissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave, thullanandā bhikkhunī dhammikaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ paṭibāhīti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.12: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave, thullanandā bhikkhunī dhammikaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ paṭibāhissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.14: evañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.15.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī dhammikaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ paṭibāheyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:2.1.8: kathaṃ idaṃ kaṭhinaṃ uddhareyyāti paṭibāhati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:2.2.6: naggavaggo tatiyo. tassuddānaṃ: naggodakaṃ visibbetvā - pañcāhasaṃkamānīyaṃ gaṇavibhaṅga samaṇaṃ - dubbalaṃ kaṭhinena cāti.
